name: Rice (Paddy)
description: Staple kharif cereal crop of Bihar and Indo-Gangetic plains requiring high moisture and standing water.

name: Wheat
description: Major rabi cereal crop in North India thriving in cool winters and fertile loamy soils.

name: Maize
description: Versatile cereal crop grown across Kharif Rabi and Zaid seasons in Bihar with high yield potential.

name: Chickpea (Gram)
description: Key rabi pulse crop fixing atmospheric nitrogen and suitable for medium to heavy soils with moderate moisture.

name: Lentil (Masoor)
description: Cool-season rabi pulse widely cultivated in Bihar diara and tal regions after rice harvest.

name: Arhar (Pigeon Pea)
description: Long-duration deep-rooted pulse crop resilient to moisture stress and excellent for intercropping.

name: Moong (Green Gram)
description: Short-duration pulse ideal for catch crop and soil enrichment in Zaid (summer) and Kharif.

name: Urad (Black Gram)
description: Nutritious pulse crop suited for warm humid conditions and loamy soils in Kharif/Summer.

name: Mustard
description: Premier rabi oilseed crop of Bihar with high oil content and moderate water requirements.

name: Rapeseed (Toria)
description: Short-duration rabi oilseed suitable as a preceding crop before late wheat in crop rotations.

name: Groundnut
description: Kharif and summer oilseed preferring well-drained sandy loam soil with moderate irrigation.

name: Sugarcane
description: Major commercial cash crop in North Bihar supplying local sugar mills and requiring substantial irrigation.

name: Potato
description: High-value rabi tuber crop extensively grown in Nalanda Patna and Samastipur plains.

name: Onion
description: Crucial commercial bulb crop cultivated in both Kharif and Rabi with high market demand.

name: Tomato
description: Warm and mild season vegetable grown extensively across Bihar fertile tracts.

name: Brinjal (Eggplant)
description: Hardy year-round vegetable crop with strong adaptation to varied Bihar soil types.

name: Cauliflower
description: Cool-season rabi vegetable widely produced around Patna Vaishali and Nalanda for winter markets.

name: Cabbage
description: Cool-season leafy head vegetable responding well to organic matter and balanced moisture.

name: Okra (Bhindi)
description: Popular warm-season summer/kharif vegetable with fast picking turnaround and good returns.
